text: Hi All! We are in the family reunification process for the third year. We have been applying through the Netanya branch so far and our online application is due in June for the next Visa that needs to be renewed in September. The problem is that we're looking to move to another city in July. We don't have an address yet so we don't have anything to notify yet, and would obviously prefer to hand them the details we already have. What do we do after we do move in between our online application and the actual meeting in Sep?
